svg.title: Big-Account Math, From Portfolio to Porter Bill Rate
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-big-account-math-funnel; chapter number: 6; chart type: funnel; title: Big-Account Math, From Portfolio to Porter Bill Rate; subtitle: Five $5k accounts down to the $26 hour that prices a day porter; caption: Five $5k accounts equal $300,000 a year, and a 4-hour labor-only day porter prices at $2,262 a month on 87 billable hours at a $26 bill rate.; assumptions note: Values mix units by design and narrow from annual portfolio revenue to a single bill-rate hour. Every figure is stated by the practitioners; none is modeled.; note: Sources The Janitorial Store (1c9Ty46MQbg at 00:01:28) for porter pricing; Big Accounts chapter summary for the five $5k accounts figure; OctoClean Media (52I2LNERY3E at 00:20:41) for the wage-plus-load gate.; stages: label: Five $5k office accounts; value: 300000; display: $300,000 a year; conversion: Portfolio target; detail: Five accounts at $5,000 a month each.; label: One $5k office account; value: 5000; display: $5,000 a month; conversion: One of five accounts; detail: Large accounts carry 35-40% gross margin versus about 50-60% on small ones.; label: 4-hour day porter price; value: 2262; display: $2,262 a month; conversion: 87 hrs x $26; detail: Labor-only porter, 4 hours a day, 5 days, 10am-2pm.; label: Porter billable hours; value: 87; display: 87 hours a month; conversion: 1,040 hrs a year divided by 12, rounded; detail: A day porter can handle a zone of about 30 to 40 bathroom fixtures.; label: Porter bill rate; value: 26; display: $26 an hour; conversion: $18 wage loaded with taxes and profit; detail: Bidding $16 on a $15 wage loses money on every hour.

circle.title: label: Five $5k office accounts; value: 300000; display: $300,000 a year; conversion: Portfolio target; detail: Five accounts at $5,000 a month each.
label: One $5k office account; value: 5000; display: $5,000 a month; conversion: One of five accounts; detail: Large accounts carry 35-40% gross margin versus about 50-60% on small ones.
label: 4-hour day porter price; value: 2262; display: $2,262 a month; conversion: 87 hrs x $26; detail: Labor-only porter, 4 hours a day, 5 days, 10am-2pm.
label: Porter billable hours; value: 87; display: 87 hours a month; conversion: 1,040 hrs a year divided by 12, rounded; detail: A day porter can handle a zone of about 30 to 40 bathroom fixtures.
label: Porter bill rate; value: 26; display: $26 an hour; conversion: $18 wage loaded with taxes and profit; detail: Bidding $16 on a $15 wage loses money on every hour.

text.title: Assumptions: Values mix units by design and narrow from annual portfolio revenue to a single bill-rate hour. Every figure is stated by the practitioners; none is modeled.
